structured.feedback: It wrongly says the set has "two Classic Cocoa Brown" pens, when the title lists one 10mm Classic and one Cocoa Brown. It also overpromises with "full day" and "Endless Looks", never uses the key terms waterproof or smudgeproof, and blurs features and benefits.
